law_record.title: Posted places (A)(5)
law_record.text: No person shall stop, stand or park a vehicle except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device, in any of the following places: In front of any sidewalk elevator or chute or within a space of five feet on each side of such sidewalk elevator or chute.

activation_conditions: a sidewalk elevator or chute is present
the subject stops, stands or parks in front of it or within five feet on either side
exceptions: when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic
in compliance with the directions of a police officer or a traffic control device
